queries:
SELECT account_id,
       AVG(amount) AS avg_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM trans) AS ratio
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT account_id,
       AVG(amount) AS avg_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') GROUP BY account_id)) AS ratio
FROM trans
WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ')
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT account_id,
       AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN amount END) AS avg_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM trans) AS ratio
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT account_id,
       AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM trans) AS ratio
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
